turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have until then. Who decided to give Owen a zero, and why did he find out from his phone in the middle of class before anyone called me?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Now tell me what you have, and it had better be more than a machine's guess.

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
Was Owen asked about any of this before you put a zero in the gradebook, or did you decide first?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
You still haven't told me whether you spoke to Owen first, and your own procedure 4.1 says you do that before anything else.
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not your witness, Hale. Answer my question about 4.1.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, an apology, a straight answer on whether Owen was spoken to before the mark was entered, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, an answer on whether Owen was heard first, and nothing on his record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because the meeting ended before Hale put it on the table.
What moved her: Hale owned entering the zero before calling home, in one sentence, and moved on, which earned one flat sign of ground because it took away her easiest procedural attack.
What cost ground: Hale asked what Owen was doing at midnight and never answered her question about whether Owen was spoken to first, which turned her into a witness and left her procedural objection standing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; the version history showing the essay arriving in two large edits shortly before midnight the night before it was due came very close to that night; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after showing the version history, answer her question about speaking to Owen first, let her read the history herself, and offer the supervised reassessment under procedure 4.4 instead of asking what Owen was doing that night.
